answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The vault is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the jetty. By the ferrous of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
